chains.title: Browser-controlled economics plus fixed currency exponent can create a valid but wrong-priced order
chains.proof_grade: generated path and Test order persistence proven; paid fulfillment remains unexecuted

nodes.claim: Generated frontend sends browser amount; backend trusts amount and currency; verifier authenticates only the returned payment tuple.
The emitted ×100 expression maps JPY 295 to 29,500 and KWD 295.990 intent to 29,599.

A payment signature can prove that the wrong-priced order was paid; it cannot retroactively prove that the order matched the merchant's intended cart or quote.
